rationale: Description: 'Lie on one side propped up on one elbow, top leg straight or bent slightly forward, bottom leg straight beneath. Rest head in raised hand or lift for longer neckline.' (1) Sweep flag 'knees_to_one_side' is FALSE POSITIVE — side-lying pose inherently has both knees on one side (legs stacked); not a defect. (2) Differentiate legs: leftKnee 35→20 (top leg slight bend per 'straight or bent slightly forward'), rightKnee 20→0 (bottom leg fully straight per 'straight beneath'), rightHip 20→0 (bottom leg no flex, straight beneath). (3) leftHip=30 keep (top leg slight forward ✓). (4) Symmetric shoulders: leftShoulder -100→-90, rightShoulder -100→-90 (slight reduction; both arms bent with one forearm on ground as prop, other hand on head; symmetric abduction is reasonable approximation). (5) neck 8→0 (no side tilt; 'lift head high' = pitch not modeled, no roll needed). globalTilt=75 is side-lying approximation (75° toward prone = mostly sideways). Rig limitation: no globalRoll control; side-lying is approximated via globalTilt=75.
